## Design preservation
All 8 CG-12 contracts kept with exact ids/kinds/order and their warnings (uniform-plus-length loop topology, fixed `n`, basin defined by `lim L(f^k x)=0` and identified with a short class only after clopenness, strict nondegeneracy deferred to the product perturbation, explicit `η=(π−r)/2`, intrinsic quadrilateral δ, retained `−δ²` term, no shrinkability in the disk construction). One prerequisite the design route silently needs was added **before its consumers**: `lem-cg-cat-one-short-and-closed-local-geodesics` (BH II.1.4 adapted: unique short geodesics, local geodesics of length ≤ π are geodesics, no nonconstant closed local geodesic in a diameter-<π ball). It is flagged in the notes as a candidate re-home to the CAT page for owner reconciliation. Plan-spec agrees on page-level data with empty item arrays — no conflict.

## Honest verification notes
- I independently re-derived and corrected the route where it mattered: the choice-free uniform-radius proof (open cover + Lebesgue number), the exact λ with the `−δ²` term, the basin⇔shrinkability equivalence (clopenness + explicit midpoint homotopy), and short-loop-only phrasing of the `m` statements.
- **AC boundary declared and carried:** 8 items (disk, perturbation, decrement, short-loop control, all 4 B examples) inherit AC through `thm-cg-compact-local-cat-one-short-circle-criterion` (Ascoli); the other 5 items are choice-free.
- **Bowditch reading limit stated honestly:** the scan has no text layer and this environment has no OCR/image input, so I did not re-read the printed pages myself; I used the commissioned visual reading recorded in `geometric-source-report.md`, cross-checked every used claim against BH/Davis where they overlap, and recorded two source typos (Bowditch 3.2.1 “≤−1” for ≤1; Davis I.2.16's printed normalisation) — neither consumed.
